name: menubutton
title: Menu
description: s6-modular-g (interfaces, phase 2): a small button at the bottom right, that opens the game menu whatever the interface's keys took; moved on its Layout tab or in edit mode. s6-ui-core (round 60): a shared panel, the Interface tab's Menu page under All interfaces, off by default in Modern and on in 7.x and 5.x.
